FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{console.log(JSON.parse(d).file_path||'')}catch(e){}}"); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [[ "$FILE" == */app/* ]] && [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|css|md|json)$ ]]; then cd "$(dirname "$FILE")" && cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/app" 2>/dev/null && [ -f package.json ] && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$FILE" 2>&1 | tail -3 || true; fi
